text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
